name: Chapel · Evergreen
description: Church wedding — a green envelope with a wax seal, dates under frosted vellum, stationery cards for each event, candles and white florals.
changelog: Reply card title: "We’d love to celebrate with you" instead of "Will you celebrate with us?" (hosts asked for a line that doesn't start with "Will you").

credits.artwork: Painted for Everso with an image model (Gemini), cut out and finished by hand.
